notes: If the file holding your progress was ever damaged — a crash partway through a save, a bad sector, a sync that went wrong — the Reach quietly stopped recording anything new. Not for that session: forever. Every shrine you attuned and every place you found came back as "it may not remember past this waking", every waking, and nothing you could do inside the game would clear it.
Damaged progress is now set aside instead. The Reach says so once, keeps the damaged pages exactly as they were, and begins remembering again from where you stand.
Nothing is thrown away. The old pages are kept beside your progress rather than deleted, so anything recoverable stays recoverable.

Progress written by a NEWER version of the game is still left strictly alone, as before — that is somebody's real progress, and this build will not touch it. Only pages that no version could read are set aside, and only once they have clearly been abandoned rather than half-written a moment ago.
title: Damaged progress no longer stops the Reach remembering
